explication: This repository is a curated library of architecture and engineering documents, not a software runtime. Readers browse materials organized by company or topic; the README describes those organizational rules. Contributors can propose additional articles or documents through a pull request or issue. The tree shows the collection’s major subject areas, but no source excerpts establish relationships among individual documents, so the graph models collections rather than an invented technical workflow.
